title: AudioMode
description: The audio-rights mode of an output (PRD REQ-056). Every output declares exactly one. `cross_platform_cleared` = a track licensed for the intended commercial uses and territories; `byo_licensed` = a user-supplied track with recorded rights; `native_audio_plan` = export dialogue/SFX and add a platform-library track during native publishing. A track cleared on one platform is NOT presumed portable to another — the mode records the plan, and the deterministic rights gate checks a cleared/BYO track carries evidence.
